claims.claim: It is a Brother SE630 computerized sewing and embroidery machine
claims.evidence: Report shows Brother brand and a sewing machine with an LCD screen, but the model is not readable and embroidery function is not shown.
No country-of-origin marking is mentioned in the report.
Still photos cannot show motor operation; the report says power-on is not shown.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual are included
claims.evidence: The report lists power cord, foot pedal, bobbins, needles, and manuals as not shown.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history is not shown and cannot be proven by photos.

risks.risk: The machine does not power on or stitch correctly.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine powering on and stitching a piece of fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, for parts or repair only.

risks.risk: Included accessories are missing or incomplete.
risks.proof: A photo showing the power cord, foot pedal, bobbins, needles, and manual together with the machine.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as machine only, with no accessories or manual.

risks.risk: Age and manufacture year are unknown, affecting remaining lifespan and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label or manufacture date sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an older machine of unknown age.

risks.risk: Hidden wear or previous repairs are not visible.
risks.proof: A close-up video panning over the machine body, needle area, and feed dogs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having unknown repair history and possible hidden wear.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial label to confirm whether it is an SE630.
Video clip of the machine powering on and stitching.
Photo of all included accessories and the original manual.
Close-up video of the machine's exterior and needle area to check for wear or repairs.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Brother sewing machine, so it can be priced at its worst case as an untested used machine without accessories; the claimed SE630 model and working condition are unproven and would raise the price.
